post:/api/v5/plugin-server-overview/refr.summary:
Manually trigger a reconciliation between the DB and the plugins actually
reported by each EC2 instance. Runs the same logic as the periodic background
sync, enqueued as a background job — returns the job ID so the caller can poll
status via the background-job API. Rapid re-submits within the configured
cooldown window reuse the in-flight/recent job's ID; the response carries a
`Reused` flag and a human-readable `Message` so the UI can show an
info-level toast (including who triggered the shared job) instead of an error.

children.name: startedBy

children.description: When the reused job was created. Null when a new job was enqueued.
children.name: startedAt

children.description: Human-readable hint for the UI to display as toast/message.

Get eligible EC2 instances for this profile as a Brand → Server → Instances tree.
Only servers that have at least one rule assigned in the profile are returned; under each
server, every active EC2 instance (Main / Backup / Trade) is listed so the operator can
pick per-instance sync targets.

post:/api/v5/profiles/{id}/sync.summary:
Generate dynamic leverage YAML from this profile and sync to selected servers as a background job.
Returns a background job ID that can be polled for progress and results.
Per-server results (success/failure, SSM CommandId, AutoReload outcome) are stored in the job's Result field.

parameters.description: Target EC2 server map IDs (per-instance, e.g. Main / Backup / Trade) to deploy the generated YAML to.
parameters.name: ec2ServerMapIds

parameters.description:
Whether to automatically reload plugin parameters after sync. Defaults to true so the
rendered YAML takes effect immediately; set false only when the operator wants to push
the file but defer the reload (e.g. coordinated multi-step rollout).
parameters.name: autoReload
